content:
rita: Heads-up from onyx-v1 int6 onboarding: strange detok/kvcache interaction on vertical CJK + inline-RTL docs. Full eval drop on vertical_ruby_hanja_ar test: fp16 BLEU=33.0 -> onyx-int6 BLEU=28.1. Also a handful of mirrored/shifted brackets and broken ZWJ emoji sequences in mixed-orient samples.

cheng: hmm that's a big delta. paste eval command + raw outputs?

rita: ran on ci-evals: 
```
python tools/eval_translate.py \
  --model=onyx-v1:quant=int6:opt=fast \
  --testset=data/vertical_ruby_hanja_ar.jsonl \
  --metrics=bleu,chrf,exact_match --batch=56
```
raw: onyx-int6 BLEU=28.1 chrF=43.2 EM=0.61 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=33.0 chrF=48.9 EM=0.69. eval-bot: stat-diff {"bleu":"-4.9","chrf":"-5.7","em":"-0.08"} (p<0.01).

hiro: can you paste a minimal failing example (src / ref / onyx-int6 output)? tokenization drift or detok ordering?

rita: minimal pair below (kept short):
src: "\u65e5\u672c\u8a18\u9332\u3000(\u6ce8)\u300b\u0627\u0628\u062c"
ref: "\u65e5\u672c\u8a18\u9332\u3000(\u6ce8)\u300d\u53c2\u8003\u0627\u0628\u062c"
onyx-int6: "\u65e5\u672c\u8a18\u9332\u3000(\u6ce8\u53c2)\u300b\u0627\u0628\u062c"
notes: parentheses content moved before the reference token and closing bracket glyph changed to fullwidth close-angle on the mixed-RTL boundary. In other samples ZWJ heart sequences split: "\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u2764\ufe0f" -> "\ud83d\ude0a \ufe0f\u200d\u2764".

cheng: that looks like a post-detok bidi/reordering problem. Did token_map change for the quant build?

rita: token_map unchanged (token_map_v5.json). The int6 runtime enabled an experimental "kv-merge" optimization that coalesces adjacent prefix tokens to reduce KV-store entries and does an early detok merge to save tokens. Suspect the early merge runs before bidi anchoring/direction-aware stitching.

hiro: can you run two quick variants on bench-small: A) int6 with kv-merge disabled; B) int6 with kv-merge but force detok after bidi reflow? That should isolate ordering.

rita: queued jobs: 3723456805-A and 3723456812-B. Also added 12 human-inspect samples to ci/regress/vertical_ruby_hanja_manual.jsonl (PR #4217) with focus on bracket/ZWJ/RTL cases.

eval-bot: quick-smoke (subset): onyx-int6-subset BLEU=28.4 -> baseline-subset BLEU=33.2. queued variant A/B.

qa: variant A (kv-merge off) subset results: BLEU=31.8 chrF=47.6. variant B (detok-after-bidi) subset: BLEU=32.6 chrF=48.0. Both recover most of the gap; B is slightly better.

cheng: great signal. sounds like ordering is the issue. if detok-after-bidi recovers but kv-merge-off also helps, short-term fix: disable kv-merge for mixed-orient or vertical locales, and add a config flag to ensure detok executes after bidi reordering.

hiro: i'll open a PR to change detok ordering + add unit tests for: 1) fullwidth punctuation around inline-RTL; 2) ZWJ emoji sequences; 3) ruby anchor preservation. Also will add regression gate to block kv-merge in onyx-int6 until tests pass.

rita: action items: hiro=PR for detok ordering + tests, cheng=update quant rollout checklist to include kv-merge gating, qa=run full eval once PR lands. tagging: P1 for now, escalate if any production rollouts use onyx-int6.

cheng: noted. thanks all. will keep monitoring and post the PR link here. :thumbsup:

(END)
